從 M-P 到 MLP
Two-Step Dance and XOR
d49807ff7502.en:
From M-P to MLP
The Two-Step Dance and XOR

39cc810f7c6e.zh: 一條直線切不開的世界，就疊出一個空間 Where one line fails, stack a space.
39cc810f7c6e.en: When one straight line can't cut the world apart, stack up a new space

cafa0e66fdc4.zh: 一條直線切不開 XOR，怎麼辦？<small>One line cannot cut XOR — what now?</small>
cafa0e66fdc4.en: One straight line can't cut XOR apart. Now what?

cb4069fc3837.zh: 名師導讀 · 輪子之後的引擎 After the wheel, the engine
cb4069fc3837.en: Guided Reading · After the Wheel, the Engine

8ffa0391a3c3.zh: 很多人因為看見 ChatGPT 能寫詩、Midjourney 能繪圖而走進這門課，想拯救世界，或者至少拯救期末考。Drawn by ChatGPT and Midjourney, here to save the world — or the exam.
8ffa0391a3c3.en: Many of you walked into this course because you saw ChatGPT write poems and Midjourney draw pictures, and you want to save the world, or at least save your final exam.

b9945dd65852.zh: 上一節我們弄清楚了輪子：M-P 神經元。今天不敲程式碼，我們要回答一個更狠的問題：一條直線切不開的世界，要怎麼切？Last time the wheel; today: how to cut what one line cannot.
b9945dd65852.en: Last time we figured out the wheel: the M-P neuron. Today we won't write any code; we'll answer a tougher question: when one straight line can't cut the world apart, how do we cut it?

efa173068d8e.zh: 別擔心文本裡的年份筆誤：M-P 模型誕生於 1943 年，那時連真正的電子電腦都還沒普及，McCulloch 與 Pitts 已經用數學模擬神經元。M-P was 1943, before computers went mainstream.
efa173068d8e.en: Don't worry about the typo in the year in the textbook: the M-P model was born in 1943, when real electronic computers weren't even widespread yet, and McCulloch and Pitts were already simulating neurons with mathematics.

267fe38b4a43.zh: 1943：有原則的傳聲筒 A principled relay

51731918b723.en: Output 1 only if the total reaches the bar, else 0

b9d5e731b60e.zh: M-P 神經元：加總後過門檻 · Sum then threshold
b9d5e731b60e.en: M-P neuron: sum, then pass the threshold

e68b5c770dc5.zh: 人類史上第一個「人工神經元」數學模型：McCulloch-Pitts 神經元 (M-P Neuron)，1943 年誕生。History's first artificial neuron, 1943.
e68b5c770dc5.en: The first mathematical model of an “artificial neuron” in human history: the McCulloch-Pitts neuron (M-P neuron), born in 1943.

ab8d8630d6b1.zh: 有原則的傳聲筒：把收到的 1 加起來，達標才大叫 1，沒達標就安靜輸出 0。A relay that shouts 1 only past its threshold.
ab8d8630d6b1.en: A relay with principles: it adds up the 1s it receives, shouts 1 only if the total reaches the bar, and quietly outputs 0 if it doesn't.

642154eb251a.zh: 三個特點 · 簡單到不可思議 Three simple traits

55ce0dad80d5.zh: 只聽得懂 1 或 0，回答也只有 1 或 0，不搞曖昧。Only 1 or 0, never in-between.
55ce0dad80d5.en: It only understands 1 or 0, and it only answers 1 or 0. No mixed signals.

2072548a60cc.zh: 把所有 1 加起來，總分達標才輸出 1，否則輸出 0。Sum the ones; fire only past the bar.
2072548a60cc.en: Add up all the 1s; output 1 only if the total reaches the bar, otherwise output 0.

de0388bc678d.zh: 每個訊號重要性都一樣，而且寫死不能改，生來什麼樣，一輩子什麼樣。Equal weights, frozen for life; no learning.
de0388bc678d.en: Every signal is equally important, and that's hard-coded and can't be changed: the way it's born is the way it stays for life.

df0d8d83f440.zh: 為何偉大 · Why it matters

acedeff9e417.zh: 把足夠多這樣的簡單神經元連起來，就能實現 AND、OR、NOT 邏輯運算，等於用神經元做電腦能做的邏輯思考，為所有神經網路打下第一塊地基。Wired together, they compute AND, OR, NOT — the first foundation.
acedeff9e417.en: Connect enough of these simple neurons and you can implement the logic operations AND, OR, and NOT. That amounts to using neurons for the logical reasoning a computer can do, and it laid the first foundation stone for all neural networks.

097e10ef1812.zh: 數學形式 · 累積再開關 Sum then threshold

cc4fd4fb8af8.zh: 兩個特徵：$x_1$ 是不是紅色？$x_2$ 是不是圓形？M-P 約定每個輸入重要性都一樣。Two features, equal weights by design.
cc4fd4fb8af8.en: Two features: $x_1$ is it red? $x_2$ is it round? M-P stipulates that every input is equally important.

c7b25f4abab6.zh: 門檻設為 2：總分達標輸出 1，否則輸出 0。這就是 AND 的數學寫法。Threshold 2 encodes the AND logic.
c7b25f4abab6.en: Set the threshold to 2: output 1 if the total reaches it, otherwise output 0. That is how AND is written mathematically.

c7a08c216179.zh: 動手算 · 教它認紅蘋果 Spot the red apple
c7a08c216179.en: Compute by Hand · Teach It to Recognize Red Apples

da030a5e06c0.zh: 總分 $(1 \times 1) + (1 \times 1) = \mathbf{2}$，達標輸出 1，是紅蘋果！Score 2, outputs 1 — a red apple.
da030a5e06c0.en: Total $(1 \times 1) + (1 \times 1) = \mathbf{2}$: it reaches the bar, so the output is 1. It's a red apple!

0a4f274e4d98.zh: 總分 $(0 \times 1) + (0 \times 1) = \mathbf{0}$，未達標輸出 0，不是紅蘋果。Score 0, outputs 0 — not an apple.
0a4f274e4d98.en: Total $(0 \times 1) + (0 \times 1) = \mathbf{0}$: it doesn't reach the bar, so the output is 0. Not a red apple.

42056588f6a9.zh: 總分 $(0 \times 1) + (1 \times 1) = \mathbf{1}$，未達標輸出 0，也不是紅蘋果。Score 1, outputs 0 — not an apple.
42056588f6a9.en: Total $(0 \times 1) + (1 \times 1) = \mathbf{1}$: it doesn't reach the bar, so the output is 0. Not a red apple either.

e45d39321a8a.zh: 總分與輸出 · Score versus output

a1be6c16286f.zh: AND 可分，XOR 不可分 AND splits, XOR resists
a1be6c16286f.en: AND Is Separable, XOR Is Not

4219b6efc827.zh: 左 AND 門檻 1.5 線性可分 · 右 XOR 無一直線可分 · matplotlib 精準繪製
4219b6efc827.en: Left: AND with threshold 1.5 is linearly separable · Right: no single straight line separates XOR · Drawn precisely with matplotlib

13568c06f6a3.zh: 權重 $[1, 1]$、偏置 $-1.5$ 時，直線 $x_1 + x_2 = 1.5$ 把唯一的 (1, 1) 與 (0, 0)、(0, 1)、(1, 0) 完全分開。One line isolates (1,1).
13568c06f6a3.en: With weights $[1, 1]$ and bias $-1.5$, the line $x_1 + x_2 = 1.5$ completely separates the lone point (1, 1) from (0, 0), (0, 1), and (1, 0).

b31708d05e11.zh: (0, 0) 與 (1, 1) 同類，(0, 1) 與 (1, 0) 另一類，任何單一筆直直線都無法分開，呈現線性不可分。No single line can split XOR.
b31708d05e11.en: (0, 0) and (1, 1) are in one class, (0, 1) and (1, 0) in the other. No single straight line can separate them: the data are not linearly separable.

fe55a7054db3.zh: 單層網路只能畫一條直線；XOR 需要彎曲邊界，必須疊出隱藏層。One layer draws one line; XOR needs depth.
fe55a7054db3.en: A single-layer network can only draw one straight line; XOR needs a curved boundary, so we must stack a hidden layer.

03d9119d25ec.zh: MLP 結構 · 疊出新空間 Stack into new space
03d9119d25ec.en: MLP Structure · Stacking Up a New Space

2e30389476fa.zh: 隱藏層折疊空間，輸出層再切一刀
2e30389476fa.en: Hidden layer folds space; output layer makes one cut

5d8e2faa053a.zh: MLP 全連接：隱藏層折疊，輸出層切割 · Fold then cut
5d8e2faa053a.en: Fully connected MLP: the hidden layer folds, the output layer cuts

22285b55802b.zh: 單層只能畫一條直線。MLP 用隱藏層把空間折起來，讓原本纏在一起的點在新空間中變得可分。Hidden layers fold space separable.
22285b55802b.en: A single layer can only draw one straight line. An MLP uses hidden layers to fold the space, so points that were tangled together become separable in the new space.

6586a029fff7.zh: 像把紙對摺再剪一刀：對摺是隱藏層的非線性，剪一刀是輸出層的直線。Fold the paper, then one straight cut.
6586a029fff7.en: It's like folding a sheet of paper in half and then making one cut: the fold is the hidden layer's nonlinearity, and the cut is the output layer's straight line.

e0a9f43fe227.zh: 神經元兩步舞曲 Two-step dance

25a61f3b3f6d.zh: 把上一層傳來的東西乘上重要性再加起來，得到總分 $a_i$。Weight, sum, score $a_i$.
25a61f3b3f6d.en: Multiply whatever comes from the previous layer by its importance and add it all up to get the total score $a_i$.

7d441b4330ee.zh: 把總分丟進神奇開關 $\sigma(\cdot)$，得到最終輸出 $z_i$。Squash with $\sigma$, output $z_i$.
7d441b4330ee.en: Throw the total score into the magic switch $\sigma(\cdot)$ to get the final output $z_i$.

2b0c91a261d6.zh: 加上正確的非線性，就能分辨真實世界複雜到爆的資料結構。Stack deep, carve complex worlds.
2b0c91a261d6.en: Add the right nonlinearity, and you can tell apart the insanely complex data structures of the real world.

5bdfe6e93350.zh: 神經元內部運算 · Inside one neuron

da46854ec868.zh: 第一步是直線，第二步是彎曲；兩步交替，才有深度學習的魔法。Linear first, bending second — that is the magic.
da46854ec868.en: Step one is a straight line, step two is a bend; only by alternating the two steps do you get the magic of deep learning.

52ec78780027.zh: 小結 · 從傳聲筒到折紙機 Relay to folder
52ec78780027.en: Summary · From Relay to Paper-Folding Machine

e00997b43eda.zh: M-P 教會我們「加權和 $\to$ 閾值啟動」；XOR 教會我們單層的極限；MLP 用「線性加總 $+$ 非線性啟動」疊出新空間。M-P gives the rule; XOR gives the limit; MLP folds space.
e00997b43eda.en: M-P taught us “weighted sum $\to$ threshold activation”; XOR taught us the limits of a single layer; MLP uses “linear summation $+$ nonlinear activation” to stack up a new space.

62895d1115d8.zh: 文本有兩處口誤已在課堂上澄清：M-P 是 1943 年不是 1958 年；AND 示範門檻 2 與幾何圖門檻 1.5 是同一條邊界的不同寫法（$\ge 2$ 對整數點 $\Leftrightarrow$ $\gt 1.5$）。1943 not 1958; threshold 2 equals boundary 1.5.
62895d1115d8.en: Two slips in the textbook were clarified in class: M-P dates from 1943, not 1958; and the AND demo's threshold of 2 and the geometry figure's threshold of 1.5 are two ways of writing the same boundary ($\ge 2$ on integer points $\Leftrightarrow$ $\gt 1.5$).

ebb937cdc753.zh: 等權固定、無學習，但證明神經元可做邏輯運算。Logic from neurons, no learning yet.
ebb937cdc753.en: Equal, fixed weights and no learning, but it proved that neurons can perform logic operations.

ef4d0374cc83.zh: 權重可從錯誤中更新，但單層仍解不了 XOR。Learns, yet still blocked by XOR.
ef4d0374cc83.en: Weights can be updated from mistakes, but a single layer still can't solve XOR.

894b8912666d.zh: 疊出隱藏層，用非線性折疊空間，下節課讓神經元動起來。Next: depth that moves.
894b8912666d.en: Stack hidden layers and fold space with nonlinearity; next class, we get the neurons moving.

2391467faf5e.zh: 思考題 · 提取練習 Reflection

c70b84166dd2.zh: Q1. AND 邏輯下，權重 [1, 1] 時門檻應設為多少？ Threshold for AND with weights [1,1]?
c70b84166dd2.en: Q1. For AND logic with weights [1, 1], what should the threshold be?

247483dcbe2d.zh: Q2. 為何單層網路解不了 XOR？ Why can't one layer solve XOR?
247483dcbe2d.en: Q2. Why can't a single-layer network solve XOR?

0c0b73d10460.zh: 點太少 — too few points

729901c82533.zh: 計算太慢 — too slow

db08fd84838f.zh: 任何單一直線都分不開對角同類 — no single line separates
db08fd84838f.en: No single straight line can separate the diagonal same-class points

989356092157.zh: Q3. MLP 解決 XOR 的關鍵是什麼？ Key to MLP solving XOR?
989356092157.en: Q3. What is the key to how an MLP solves XOR?

b2b171c66dd5.zh: 更多資料 — more data only

15b44e26330d.zh: 隱藏層非線性折疊空間 — fold space nonlinearly
15b44e26330d.en: The hidden layer folds space nonlinearly

973a3a4f11d9.zh: 更高門檻 — higher threshold
